name: render-shot
description: A rendered shot of a model or a scene: a shot plan (camera, lens, light, look-dev preset, frames), the render in Blender (Cycles or EEVEE), Godot or Unreal (Movie Render Queue), checked previews, an art director's look at the frames, revisions.

subject.description: What to show and how (e.g. "the barrel asset, a slow turntable at dusk").

frames.description: 1 for a still, more for a turntable or a camera move

plan.title: Shot plan

render.title: Render
render.prompt: Stage: shot-render. Render the shot in docs/shot.md into renders/: blender: the blender tool (a bpy script with the camera and light, or studio_model's preview renders for an asset); godot: godot render; unreal: unreal render (Movie Render Queue, a heavy job). Look at every frame you made and fix framing, exposure and noise before you finish. Also save one frame as previews/shot.png.

review.title: Look at the frames
review.prompt: Stage: shot-review. Read the frames in renders/ (images are shown). Judge composition, the subject reading at a glance, light and exposure, noise and artefacts, against docs/shot.md. Write docs/shot-review.md with [BLOCKING|MAJOR|MINOR] findings.

revise.title: Revise
revise.prompt:
Stage: shot-revise. Address every BLOCKING and MAJOR finding in docs/shot-review.md, render again, look at the frames.

{{state.review}}
